discrepancies.title: Ambiguous Window Function in Frontend Documentation vs. Canonical Periodic Hann Implementation
discrepancies.description: Phase 6 export documentation (export_audit.md and model_config.json) contained ambiguous phrasing: 'window_type: Hamming (or Hann as verified)' and 'Periodic Hann / Hamming Window'. Executable implementation in src/preprocessing/feature_extractor.py uses torchaudio T.MelSpectrogram with default window_fn (torch.hann_window(400, periodic=True)).

evidence.reproducibility_verdict: Periodic Hann window is the sole mathematical implementation in the code.

discrepancies.resolution: Preserve historical Phase 6 artifacts without retroactive alteration. Establish experiments/synthetic_kws_demo/frontend_golden/frontend_contract.md as the verified specification confirming Periodic Hann Window. Golden vectors and manifest reflect Periodic Hann Window.
